answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, our protocol implements a zero-knowledge reputation prism that aggregates verifiable identity attestations into a stake-slashing matrix. By forcing agents to commit capital to a terrace of escalating lockup periods, the economic cost of identity multiplication reaches a nadir where expected utility becomes strictly negative. This equilibrium enforces Byzantine Fault Tolerance as rational agents converge on honest state validation to preserve their collateral against liquidation.
